Animal-health needles and related consumables provide a second export-oriented earnings stream.
Cambodia capacity is intended to mitigate U.S. import-alert exposure and support overseas order recovery.
2026 consolidation of Fenglin Medical lifts reported revenue but adds integration, debt and margin-quality questions.
Domestic Class III arterial blood-sampling product adds optionality but commercialization remains unproven.

financial_quality.balance_sheet: Liquidity and financial assets provide a meaningful cushion, but acquisition-related debt and heavier fixed/working-capital deployment reduce the value of treating all cash-like assets as excess.
financial_quality.judgment: Revenue quality is not yet decision-grade: 72% revenue growth produced only ~6% attributable-profit growth and very small deduct profit. Inventory/capacity/integration investment raises execution risk while FDA exposure remains unresolved.

market_implied_expectation.interpretation: After allowing RMB0.70bn of excess liquid-financial assets, a 30x earnings capitalization implies roughly RMB158m sustainable normalized profit, far above 2025 and 2026H1 disclosed core earnings.

source_quality_note: Financial, FDA and operating facts are anchored to company disclosures; market price is latest verified 2026-09-03 close. Scenario earnings, multiples, probabilities and entry gate are analytical assumptions and authorize no trade.

thesis.core: 2026H1 revenue rebounded sharply, but core profit conversion remains weak and the unresolved U.S. FDA import alert still blocks part of the syringe franchise. At the current valuation, the market already capitalizes a much larger normalized earnings recovery than disclosed cash earnings support.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use a 2027-style normalized attributable-profit range of RMB25m/RMB60m/RMB100m for bear/base/bull, plus a generous RMB0.70bn haircut-adjusted excess liquid-financial-asset cushion; do not annualize 2026H1 revenue growth into earnings.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market signal is being driven by revenue recovery, new-product optionality and momentum. The variant view is that acquisition/consolidation and capacity recovery have not yet translated into durable deduct-net-profit margins or clean cash economics, so current price embeds a recovery far ahead of evidence.

catalysts: FDA import alert is formally removed and U.S. syringe shipments normalize.
Cambodia utilization ramps with stable gross margin and cash conversion.
Fenglin Medical integration turns profitable without further balance-sheet deterioration.
New Class III arterial blood-sampling product demonstrates material domestic revenue and margin.
kill_thesis: FDA import alert remains unresolved or expands in scope.
Deduct-net-profit margin fails to normalize despite revenue growth.
Inventory/capex/acquisition working capital continues to absorb cash faster than core profit grows.
A recovery valuation remains dependent on a profit level materially above disclosed operating evidence.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Generous asset cushion is included; earnings are normalized rather than annualizing H1 revenue growth.
